metafields.supplier_description:
Elevate your everyday style with our chic 12-inch mid-length synthetic lace front wig, featuring a silky straight texture and natural 130% density. Designed for a flawless finish, this wig offers both elegance and ease, allowing you to switch up your look effortlessly.

Features:

  • Premium Synthetic Hair
  • 13x3 inch Lace Front Construction for a natural hairline
  • Silky Straight Texture
  • Chic Mid-Length: 12 inches
  • 130% Density for natural volume and movement
  • Heat Safe up to 302°F (150°C) for versatile styling
  • Ready-to-wear design

Care Instructions:

  • Wash gently with sulfate-free shampoo.
  • Condition with a detangler, working from ends to roots with a proper brush. Sectioning hair can aid in detangling.
  • Deep condition at least once a month to maintain softness.
  • To protect your wig while sleeping, gently tie or braid it, then use a silk scarf, bonnet, or satin pillowcase to retain moisture and prevent tangles.
  • Maintain gentle handling during brushing and styling to ensure longevity and prevent breakage.

metafields.supplier_description:
Transform your look with the flowing elegance of our 24-inch Long Wavy Synthetic Lace Front Wig. Crafted for a natural appearance and comfortable wear, this stunning piece features a luxurious wave texture and a generous 13*3" lace front, allowing for a seamless hairline and versatile styling options.

Key Features:
  • Hair Type: Premium Synthetic Fibers
  • Texture: Cascading Wavy
  • Length: 24 inches
  • Density: 130% for natural fullness
  • Lace Front: 13*3" for a seamless, natural hairline and versatile styling
  • Heat Safe: Up to 302° F (150° C) for personalized styling
Care & Maintenance:
  • Use a sulfate-free shampoo.
  • Gently detangle with a quality conditioner and wide-tooth comb or brush, starting from the ends and working upwards. Sectioning the hair can help manage tangles.
  • Deep condition at least once a month to maintain softness and luster.
  • Protect your wig while sleeping: Braid, twist, or put into a loose ponytail, then cover with a silk scarf or bonnet, or use a satin pillowcase to lock in moisture and prevent friction.
  • Remember to care for your natural scalp underneath for optimal health.
  • Handle with care: Gentle brushing and styling will preserve the integrity of the knots and extend the wig's lifespan.

metafields.supplier_title: 13*3" Lace Front Wigs Synthetic Long Straight 24" 130% Density
metafields.supplier_description:
Achieve effortlessly chic style with our Long Straight Lace Front Wig. Designed for a natural look and comfortable wear, this luxurious synthetic wig offers seamless elegance for any occasion.

Key Features:

  • Natural Lace Front: A generous 13x3" lace front creates a seamless, undetectable hairline.
  • Premium Synthetic Hair: Enjoy the look and feel of real hair with durable, high-quality fibers.
  • Sleek Straight Style: Features a beautifully smooth, long straight texture for timeless elegance.
  • Optimal Length: At 24 inches, this wig offers stunning length and versatility.
  • Comfortable Density: A natural 130% density provides a full yet lightweight feel.
  • Heat-Safe Styling: Safely style with heat tools up to 302°F (150°C) to customize your look.

Care Instructions:

  • Use a sulfate-free shampoo to preserve fiber quality.
  • Gently detangle with a proper brush, starting from the ends and working your way up. Sectioning helps prevent tangles.
  • Deep condition at least once a month to maintain softness and manageability.
  • Protect your wig while sleeping by braiding, twisting, or securing it in a ponytail, then using a silk scarf, bonnet, or satin pillowcase to retain moisture.
  • Be gentle during brushing and styling to extend the life of your wig and prevent breakage.

Specifications:

  • Length: 24 inches
  • Lace Front Size: 13x3 inches
  • Density: 130%
  • Hair Type: Premium Synthetic
  • Heat Resistance: Up to 302°F (150°C)

  • Handle with care: Gentle brushing and styling will extend the life of your wig and prevent breakage.
